description: Add an upstream callable-flow fact projection owned by semantic/runtime-demand closure. For each local callable producer that is demanded, publish canonical target function/executable evidence, ordered captures, direct surfaces, first-class boundary surfaces, escape, and opaque facts. The fact must distinguish unknown opaque surface from known direct surface and from first-class publication. It must not depend on transport descriptors or old Trash layout. Worked examples must prove the Enumerable suspend reducer has canonical reducer executables and direct two-arg surface upstream, and an opaque escaped callable with no known surface remains explicitly opaque/first-class. Update outline.md and proposal.html with the fact owner and exact product.
title: Transport authority: publish upstream callable-flow facts
